body:
Myk's order, 2026-08-27: a user's manual for the quick start. Cover npm i -g, loam init (the guided flow), how tailscale must be configured for the store to be reachable, and how to create the MCP connection in claude.ai.

Build: docs/quick-start.md, the second loam_docs topic - it rides the T247 machinery (SUMMARIES entry, compiled at build, served by the tool and as a resource). Every loam command transcribed from the code, not from memory: the guided init's printed next step, serve's token requirement, the default port, the two connector flags (--public-url, --oauth-allow-redirect). The tailscale section teaches the standard funnel recipe and says plainly which parts are the reader's platform to verify. Also: the second doc triggers T247's named latent guard - build-docs.mjs gains the topic-character guard (a topic is [a-z0-9-]+, refused otherwise) the lens said was owed when a second doc arrived.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) loam_docs with no args lists quick-start with its summary; the topic serves markdown containing the install command, the funnel command, and the connector URL shape. Verify: test/server/docs-quick-start.test.ts (new file - the T247 rail is frozen).
(b) The topic-character guard refuses a doc whose filename would mint a topic outside [a-z0-9-]+, red-proven; both live topics pass. Verify: same file.
(c) The served bytes match docs/quick-start.md and the resource serves the same bytes (parity, the T247 pattern). Verify: same file.

Merge tier: docs + one build guard - rides the T249 stack; Myk merges the stack.
title: The quick-start - a human's manual from npm i to a Claude connection
